note: Dataset regression references, not model answers or accuracy evidence. Counterfactual SQL encodes plausible wrong business rules.

late_jobs_discount.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_jobs FROM projects WHERE status='complete' AND CAST(julianday(actual_end_date)-julianday(planned_end_date) AS INTEGER)>7
late_jobs_discount.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_jobs FROM projects WHERE CAST(julianday(actual_end_date)-julianday(planned_end_date) AS INTEGER)>0

on_time_handover_rate.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(julianday(actual_end_date)-julianday(planned_end_date) AS INTEGER)<=7 THEN 1 END)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate FROM projects WHERE status='complete'
on_time_handover_rate.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_end_date<=planned_end_date THEN 1 END)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate FROM projects WHERE status='complete'

material_waste_gbp.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(wasted_quantity*unit_cost_gbp) AS material_waste_gbp FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered'
material_waste_gbp.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: SELECT SUM(wasted_quantity) AS material_waste FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered'

dig_rework_cost.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(w.hours*c.hourly_rate_gbp) AS rework_cost_gbp FROM work_logs w JOIN crew c USING(crew_id) WHERE w.task_type='rework' AND c.crew_name='Dig'
dig_rework_cost.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: SELECT SUM(w.hours) AS rework_hours FROM work_logs w JOIN crew c USING(crew_id) WHERE w.task_type='rework' AND c.crew_name='Dig'

jobs_losing_money.gold_sql: WITH labour AS (SELECT w.project_id,SUM(w.hours*c.hourly_rate_gbp) AS cost FROM work_logs w JOIN crew c USING(crew_id) GROUP BY w.project_id), materials AS (SELECT project_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_gbp) AS cost FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY project_id), margins AS (SELECT p.project_id,p.project_name,p.contract_value_gbp-COALESCE(l.cost,0)-COALESCE(m.cost,0) AS gross_margin_gbp FROM projects p LEFT JOIN labour l USING(project_id) LEFT JOIN materials m USING(project_id) WHERE p.status<>'cancelled') SELECT project_name,gross_margin_gbp FROM margins WHERE gross_margin_gbp<0 ORDER BY gross_margin_gbp
jobs_losing_money.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: WITH labour AS (SELECT w.project_id,SUM(w.hours*c.hourly_rate_gbp) AS cost FROM work_logs w JOIN crew c USING(crew_id) WHERE w.task_type<>'rework' GROUP BY w.project_id), materials AS (SELECT project_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_gbp) AS cost FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY project_id), margins AS (SELECT p.project_id,p.project_name,p.contract_value_gbp-COALESCE(l.cost,0)-COALESCE(m.cost,0) AS gross_margin_gbp FROM projects p LEFT JOIN labour l USING(project_id) LEFT JOIN materials m USING(project_id) WHERE p.status<>'cancelled') SELECT project_name,gross_margin_gbp FROM margins WHERE gross_margin_gbp<0 ORDER BY gross_margin_gbp

skip_waste_share.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(wasted_quantity*unit_cost_gbp)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(quantity*unit_cost_gbp),0) AS material_waste_rate FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered'
skip_waste_share.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: SELECT AVG(wasted_quantity*1.0/NULLIF(quantity,0)) AS material_waste_rate FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered'

billable_share.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN task_type NOT IN ('tea_break','yard_tidy','rework','sprout_helping') THEN hours ELSE 0 END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(hours),0) AS billable_utilisation FROM work_logs
billable_share.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN task_type NOT IN ('tea_break','yard_tidy','rework') THEN hours ELSE 0 END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(hours),0) AS billable_utilisation FROM work_logs

supplier_skip_waste_rate.gold_sql: SELECT supplier,SUM(wasted_quantity*unit_cost_gbp)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(quantity*unit_cost_gbp),0) AS material_waste_rate FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY supplier ORDER BY material_waste_rate DESC
supplier_skip_waste_rate.plausible_wrong_rule_sql: SELECT supplier,AVG(wasted_quantity*1.0/NULLIF(quantity,0)) AS material_waste_rate FROM material_orders WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY supplier ORDER BY material_waste_rate DESC
